title: Article 39 — Certain principles of policy to be followed by the State

content.overview: Article 39 directs the State to direct its policy towards securing: adequate means of livelihood for all citizens (men and women equally); distribution of ownership and control of material resources to subserve the common good; operation of the economic system so as not to result in concentration of wealth and means of production to the common detriment; equal pay for equal work for men and women; protection of workers’ health and strength and of children against abuse and forced vocation unsuited to age or strength; and opportunities and facilities for children to develop in a healthy manner and in conditions of freedom and dignity, with childhood and youth protected against exploitation and moral and material abandonment.
content.glance: Livelihood; distribution of resources for common good; no concentration of wealth; equal pay; worker/child protection; children’s development and protection from exploitation.
content.study:
Article 39 lists concrete policy principles (clauses a–f). Clause (b) and (c) have been central to land reform and economic legislation and to the Article 31C protection for laws giving effect to these principles.

Examination: list the six heads; equal pay; common good distribution; anti-concentration; child protection; link Art 31C.

sections.heading: Policy heads (summary)
sections.body:
(a) Adequate means of livelihood (men and women equally).
(b) Distribution of material resources to subserve the common good.
(c) Economic system not to result in concentration of wealth/means of production to common detriment.
(d) Equal pay for equal work for men and women.
(e) Protection of workers’ health/strength and of children against abuse and unsuitable vocation.
(f) Children’s opportunities for healthy development; protection of childhood and youth against exploitation and abandonment.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What principles does Article 39 require the State to follow?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 39 directs the State to secure adequate means of livelihood for all citizens; distribution of ownership and control of material resources to subserve the common good; an economic system that does not concentrate wealth to the common detriment; equal pay for equal work for men and women; protection of the health and strength of workers and of children against abuse; and opportunities for children to develop in freedom and dignity with protection against exploitation.

examTips: Six policy heads; equal pay; common good; anti-concentration; link Art 31C.

keyTakeaways: Art 39: livelihood, distribution, equal pay, worker/child protection.
